name: telekinesis
lore:
### On the Manipulation of Matter: Telekinesis

To the observer, *Telekinesis* manifests as a subtle distortion in the firmament—a translucent shimmer akin to heat rising from sun-baked stone. When the caster exerts their will, the air thickens into spectral ripples or a singular, crushing palm of unseen force that defies the natural laws of weight and rest.

To the practitioner, the experience is profoundly tactile. Shaping the Weave feels like grasping a heavy, silken cord that vibrates with the low frequency of a bronze bell. One does not merely "think" an object into motion; one *pulls* it through the resistance of reality, feeling every ounce of its mass pressing against the mind’s eye.

**The Legend of the Lame Librarian**  
Chronicles attribute the spell’s codification to Archmage Elara of the High Spire. Born with withered limbs, she refused to rely on others to reach her elevated archives. It is said her longing for knowledge became a physical lever, proving that when the spirit is sufficiently honed, the mind becomes the most potent limb of all.
